title: HP Workforce Experience Platform (WXP) Integration with Microsoft Intune
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 - vendor DEX platform (HP WXP) + Intune integration: agent deployment via Intune + Entra/Graph tenant connector + operations. Priced $2995 at parity with vendor+Intune integration siblings (ANDROIDGW/NSSWG/CSCVPN/ENDPTAN).
Gap-only: no existing HP-specific product; cross-references ENDPTAN (Microsoft Endpoint Analytics) and EHEM (generic DEX monitoring) without rebuilding them.

HP WXP = formerly HP TechPulse / Proactive Insights / Adaptive Endpoint Management; fast-renamed vendor product - console paths, agent names, Graph scopes, connector app name, and network URLs flagged verify-in-tenant/HP-console, not invented. HP WXP subscription is a buyer-supplied prerequisite.
White-label; Commercial-only deliverable this run; Gov tier price-only.
